reuse.why: Extends the existing getBulkBudgetCategories selection with a parameter instead of writing new queries, though copyPreviousMonth keeps its own hidden check and gets no flag.

duplication.why: No new logic is copied; only the same optional-flag signature is repeated across the five actions.

placement.why: The hidden rule is relaxed in the shared category-selection query in server/budget/actions.ts, where the tree decides it.

scope.why: Only the flag plumbing and one focused test.

maintainability.why: Clean parameter on the shared selector, but the month-wide copyPreviousMonth action still filters hidden categories on its own and ignores the flag, the setZero signature is left unformatted, and the SQL boolean trick is a bit opaque.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five actions that use getBulkBudgetCategories pass the flag to it; copyPreviousMonth (which already used its own hidden filter over getBudgetData) is left unchanged rather than newly bypassing

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the hidden rule is changed once in the getBulkBudgetCategories SQL
